scope: Exact interventional-mean curve of a linear structural law with a measured confounder and Gaussian-like noise, the finite-sample least-squares curve of the regenerated rows, the confounded unadjusted slope, and the position of one off-support grid point relative to the observed treatment range.
independence_basis: The generator regenerates the stated rows from the integer noise recurrence and solves the exact rational normal equations of Y on 1, T, Z; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated law and the noise recurrence.
historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted and no earlier pinned numbers are reused.
redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
limitations: The law is linear, so the curve is a line and the fixture cannot detect curvature errors. The tolerance is a declared estimation band. The refuter verdicts themselves (support, placebo treatment, random common cause, data subset) are asserted against these truths and against the planted off-support grid point, not derived by the reference; the refuters' power against planted breaks of the procedure is pinned on injected refits beside the implementation. No uncertainty or calibration.
